description: This file implements a TextParser and PathParser classes within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The TextParser handles reading and extracting text segments based on delimiters, while PathParser parses filesystem paths into components such as drive, directory, filename, extension, and base filename.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class providing functionality to parse text input streams, capable of reading text segments based on delimiters and handling position within the text.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class that parses filesystem paths into components such as drive letter, directory path, filename, extension, and base filename.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads a segment of text from the input, delimited by specified delimiters or quotes.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text segment and stores it in an OptionalType<TextFragment> result.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a file path into its components: drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
